# Name search

## Accepted behavior

search_items(items, query) matches Unicode case-insensitive substrings in input order. STRASSE matches Straße. An empty query returns all items; absent matches and empty input return []. Inputs are validated; shelf-message and stock-total behavior stays unchanged. The repository design is docs/planning/search/design.md.
